maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

chunks.text:
[Intro]
{tanpura drone, a fast mridangam roll, the female voice sings one quick raga phrase, the full beat drops at 4 s}
(aa-aa-aa)
Semma paiyan naanae!
(Semma!)
positive_styles: Carnatic classical music is the base: a modern Tamil dance song built on a real Carnatic kriti-style melody, with modern Western sounds layered on top, swaggering and cheeky breakup anthem, a big singalong

raga Hamsadhwani (a bright five-note scale) in D: D E F# A C# only, no G, no B; the melody climbs D E F# A C# D and falls D C# A F# E D, leans on F# and C#, sung-style phrasing with gamakam: slides into notes, a wide shake on E and A, grace notes before long notes
constant tanpura drone on D and A underneath everything, modal harmony on a D pedal, almost no chord changes, the melody carries the song

adi talam, one steady 104 BPM dance groove from start to end: a real mridangam, ghatam and kanjira play the core rhythm with fast Carnatic patterns and korvai endings, a modern punchy kick, snap and deep sub bass lock to the mridangam's bass strokes
a real Carnatic violin and veena, played by real musicians, close and dry, no heavy echo, answer the voice with the raga phrases
modern Western layer on top: a plucky synth doubling the raga riff, retro brass stabs, a wide bright modern mix
a Carnatic-trained young male voice singing in Tamil with clear diction and real gamakam, cheeky swagger, playful English words
a Carnatic-trained young female voice singing fast sargam swaras (sa ri ga pa ni) and soaring raga phrases between his lines
a gang of friends shouting short real Tamil word answers back (Semma! Maaradhae! Yaaru? Aiyyo!) like a dance crowd
loud, bright, punchy mix with big low end
clear Tamil diction, each line one two-bar phrase, first word on beat 1, a breath after each line, keep the same melody, groove and sound as the reference
a short punchy opening: the beat is in by 4 s, he sings the hook name once with swagger on the drop, the gang shouts 'Semma!'

brief.notes: Jithesh 31 Oct 10:11-10:12: the 3-min re-render 'not even connected to v4'; keep THIS track (v4 take 2), a bit longer, small correction: the 'Semma paiyan' start is not good. v4 take 2 stored for inpainting (semma-paiyan-source, song id in upload.json). Its transcript shows a 15 s intro and garbled konnakol-like words until the first 'Semma paiyan' at 28.6 s. Plan: new short opening + verses + hooks regenerated with conditioning_ref on the matching v4 slices (hook xhigh) so the tune stays, v4's own instrumental 4-15 s and its ending 56-60 s kept exactly, v5 lyrics + verse 2 + bridge.

story: A Chennai guy gets dumped by text on a Monday and brags he is the best guy she will ever find, dancing the hurt away with his friends. Twist: he accidentally likes her new photo.
human_work: to be added by the owner: melody, take choice, edits, mix
